text:
The pyramids at Giza were built by ancient Egyptian workers around 2560–2500 BCE, under the Fourth Dynasty pharaohs Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure, as royal tombs. Archaeological evidence, including workers' villages and tombs, shows a skilled, organized workforce of paid laborers rather than slaves. Some pyramids elsewhere in Egypt predate these, and the Giza builders' exact methods are still debated in detail.
